method: Cataclysm embeds HW1's kas2c FunctionCall table in .data at 0x755048 (487 x 0x990-byte entries: KAS name, returnsNumber, realName, typed params), used by a dev-console 'KAS' command (0x45f270) whose generated dispatcher 0x45b9a0 switches on an ELF-style case-folded string hash (0x491860) of the KAS name and calls the realName function. Re-implementing that hash over every table name and matching it to the 486 dispatcher branches gave the address of every kasf* function (verified: 290 of 291 HW1-named kasf addresses ascend in HW1 KASFunc.c source order; the exception is kasfTutShowBackButton in the tutorial-button group Cataclysm extended). KAS.c runtime, Timer.c, HS.c and SinglePlayer/Tutor helpers were matched to HW1 source by decompiled bodies, call order (kasSave/kasLoad/kasLabelledEntitiesDestroy/kasMissionStart) and caller files. The 2,085 kas2c-generated mission Init/Watch functions (0x5d6fe0-0x670a10) were recovered by recursive-descent disassembly from the 18 kasMissionStart call sites through kasFSMCreate/kasJump pointer arguments, but Ghidra has no functions in that range, so they are NOT proposed here; all 2,085 are listed with addresses, sizes and kas2c-style names (FSM/state names recovered from the 28-bit name hashes) in docs/mission-code-map.md for a function-creation pass. Two ICF-folded empty stubs (0x49ae30 'seekdir', 0x6fe9a0 'telldir', each shared by several kasf names and many non-KAS callers) are deliberately left out.
